Source-side words under one task/text/version basis
Target-side delivered words under one task/text/version basis
Words reviewed in this pass; repeated exposure, not unique coverage

rows.remainingGap: No signed net delta or document snapshot/latest-state semantics. Four positive manual bases remain separate; no text/version/span identity or automatic unique-coverage dedup. Reviewed exposure is explicitly narrowed, not generic unique processed volume.
rows.definition: Optional word-count family: every value identifies a text/version and exactly one counting basis. A document snapshot, session net change, session gross additions, source-side translation words, target-side delivered words, and reviewed/processed words are distinct quantities and must not share an unqualified total. Never infer session-written words from the final document length.

variants.meaning: Explicitly known unique observation-record total

rows.remainingGap: Nights, observation records and route references stay separate. No observation registry; photos, species and individuals are not observation records.
rows.definition: Использовать только если один считаемый элемент — уникальная observation record по тому же определению; sample, taxon/species count, photo count, individual objects and instrument readings are different.

variants.meaning: Pages actually read of one named edition, with explicit rereading policy

rows.remainingGap: Count is reading volume, not final page number or deduplicated unique coverage.
rows.definition: Same reading-volume semantics; retain work/edition, count-vs-position, rereading; not a session completion count.

variants.meaning: New outputs of one explicitly named object type

rows.remainingGap: Editing an existing output is not a new object. Known aggregate is possible; cross-session object identity/dedup is absent.
rows.definition: Reuse same new-output semantics across art, work and education; do not count edits as a new artifact.

variants.meaning: Count of one named harvested product
Harvest mass
Harvest volume

rows.remainingGap: Choose crop/variety/site and harvest versus cumulative season basis. No harvest-event identity; event count differs from product amount.
rows.definition: For same crop/product, site, unit, dated harvest amount; use work/project context as an independent axis if applicable, do not create a second harvest amount.

variants.meaning: Count of sowing events under one convention
Count of planted/surviving plants at one stated stage
Planted area under one plot convention
Row/bed length under one convention
Optional container/site label or local ID

rows.remainingGap: Fractional area and length are supported, not forced to integers. Crop/season/stage and plot identity remain user-declared; not harvested yield.
rows.definition: Reuse only same planting/crop amount and site semantics; production/business status remains context.

variants.meaning: Known occurrences of one named gardening task

rows.remainingGap: Choose group event versus individual plants watered explicitly; not harvest amount or automatic quality score.
rows.definition: Reuse for same explicit crop-care/planting event definition; distinct from harvest quantity.

variants.meaning: Count of one named item/package definition
Mass of one named material/product
Volume of one named material/product

rows.remainingGap: One chosen product/group/period amount; no per-animal attribution required. Daily total must not be duplicated as individual amounts; group/period identity not structured.
rows.definition: Reuse same aggregate by animal group/site/product/time; no per-animal attribution required.

variants.meaning: Known distinct trips under one chosen trip boundary

rows.remainingGap: No trip identities. Legs, stops and transfers are not extra trips; distance is independent.
rows.definition: A trip is distinct from route stops, distance and duration; use one event identity in work context rather than duplicate the count.

variants.meaning: Portions under one named portion definition and one stage

rows.remainingGap: Planned/prepared/served/left are separate. Portion count does not assert equal volumes or identify meals.
rows.definition: If counting portions prepared/served/left, reuse that exact stage and portion definition; portions need not be equal volume.

Known machine cycles at one stage

rows.definition: Reuse exact batch/cycle count in professional laundry context if counted entity is still one laundry load/cycle; do not count service work steps as cycles.

variants.meaning: Executions of one exercise; choose per-set or whole-target total explicitly

rows.remainingGap: No set identity; never multiply repetitions by set count implicitly.
rows.definition: Reuse only for explicit repeated executions of the same named exercise/movement and compatible session/set boundary. Do not reuse for flashcard answers, card reviews, language repetitions, completed units or arbitrary workflow retries; those have distinct semantics.
